native_adaptation.effects: An explicit Ratatui state machine replaces React layout and passive effects.
native_adaptation.scheduler: The application tick settles one trailing 150 ms selection deadline.
native_adaptation.registry_identity: A monotonic native registry generation rejects retired selection work and reseeds projection baselines.
native_adaptation.file_identity: A monotonic review projection generation reproduces replacement-object attention without exposing renderer identity.
native_adaptation.ownership: Owned Rust payloads and per-process NDJSON serialization replace frozen JavaScript object graphs.

does not emit hunk_viewed when the settled selection has no hunk

blocks a retired registry timer during the layout-to-passive cleanup window
establishes file-view projection again after a registry replaces one that already emitted
suppresses changed projection baselines when a replacement registry first mounts
retires delayed work from a replaced registry and routes imperative events to the current one

does not emit note_changed for the initial saved-note list
